summary.en: A name snaps through the face's widths once a beat, condensed to normal, with a small punch-in on each step: the type breathes with the bar.
summary.zh: 名字每拍在字体的宽度之间跳一次，从窄到正常，每次轻推一下镜头：字跟着小节呼吸。

fits: A name or one word held over a bar on a drop.
notFor: Body text; words read while they change; faces without a width axis in English.

intent.en: The name moves with the music without moving at all: same place, same letters, a new width on every beat.
intent.zh: 名字跟着音乐动却没挪位置：同一位置、同样的字，每拍换一个宽度。

content.en: One word (≤ 10 chars) set in a variable face with a width axis.

fits.zh: 在 drop 上停留一个小节的名字或单词。

en: Fit the word at its widest step so no jump leaves the margins.
Steps, not tweens: a slide between widths reads as a rubber effect.
zh: 按最宽一步定字号，跳宽时不出边距。
是跳，不是渐变：宽度之间滑过去会像橡皮效果。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
